messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: GPU memory pressure detected in pool=west2a-gpu, metric=gpu_mem.used_percent > 92% for 2m, alert=pd_98765 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident pd_98765 created and routed to schedule=oncall-sre (notify: maya)
maya: acked. pulling traces now. any known deploys?
andrew: no deploys. seeing increase in inference latency for model=redwood-vicuna-13b, 4xx/5xx ~3-5% for some customers (acme-app).
sre-ops: grabbing nvml/pool stats, nodes with highest pressure: gpu-w2a-07 (95%), gpu-w2a-09 (93%). KV cache evictions spiked ~30s before alert.
maya: good, starting controlled drain on gpu-w2a-07. moving active pods -> fallback pool. command: ```kubectl drain gpu-w2a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60```
julia: copying logs to /tmp/pd_pd_98765.log and sharing snippet: ```2026-03-16T21:02:11Z nvml: OOM reclaim attempted, cudaErrorUnknown, eviction_count=42```
andrew: routing rule applied: traffic for acme-app -> region fallback west2b-dedicated (policy=elastic-fallback, batch_size=1). expect some latency increase but fewer OOMs.
sre-ops: drain in progress on gpu-w2a-07, evicting 6 pods, 3 completed. monitoring autorecovery and kvcache hit rate.
maya: noticed autoretry bursts from client causing small fanout to many hosts. throttling rule enabled for redwood-api: max_concurrent_per_customer=20.
incident-bot: Escalation pending: 12m since page fired, no second ack. If no response, will escalate to schedule=senior-sre.
andrew: i'm taking second-shift handoff. will stay until stabilized. @maya handing off.
maya: thanks. handoff notes: drained gpu-w2a-07, still watching gpu-w2a-09 at 92-94%. KV cache tuning suggestion: lower prefetch window for vicuna-13b sessions.
julia: customer impact: acme-app error spike aligns with time window 21:01-21:07 UTC, roughly 4K requests affected, visible retries. CS notified with summary.
andrew: running small hotfix: reduce kvcache size for new sessions and disable aggressive prefetch for 10m. applying now.
sre-ops: hotfix applied, metrics: gpu-w2a-09 dropping to 88% over 2m, inference errors for acme-app down to ~0.8%.
maya: ack closing oncall loop. will follow up with postmortem if we see recurrence.
incident-bot: Alert pd_98765 auto-resolved (condition returned to normal).
pagerduty: Incident pd_98765 status: resolved, duration 00:09:50.
andrew: leaving note: recommend follow-up runbook update: add prefetch backoff by default for model redwood-vicuna-13b and a cadence for kvcache eviction metrics.
julia: copied logs + perf graphs to #incidents and attached to PD ticket.
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
